items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: Cotton Week, Morgan and I, we had McCurdy's on Canal Street... our people played banjo and Morgan was playing a guitar

ctx.x: Yeah there's another one you're talking about up in Lines and Chalmers.

Yeah I read up there with Howard and what's his name? Abbey Williams? Abbey Howard and what's this guy's name? Morgan, you know, Andrew Morgan. And Handy too was there wasn't it? That sometimes but mostly it was Morgan and Kit Howard.
You must have switched to guitar in the 30s sometimes.
